title: MGIT Student Ms. Medishetty Srujana Honored with Gold Medal for B.Tech (Civil Engineering) Academic Excellence by Hon'ble Governor of Telangana State - MGIT

## MGIT Student Ms. Medishetty Srujana Honored with Gold Medal for B.Tech (Civil Engineering) Academic Excellence by Hon’ble Governor of Telangana State

News Date : 18 Mar 2023News ReportWe are extremely delighted to announce that one of our outstanding students, Ms.MedishettySrujana, has been honored with the Gold Medal for academic excellence in B.Tech (CivilEngineering) by JNTUH. Ms.Medishetty Srujana has truly made us proud with herremarkable achievements and dedication towards her academic pursuits.Ms.Medishetty Srujana pursued her B.Tech (Civil Engineering) at our esteemed institutionand has been a consistently exceptional performer throughout her academic journey. Shecompleted her studies in 2021-2022, bearing a roll no 18261A0179 and maintained animpressive academic record of 8.36 GPA. Her excellent academic performance is a testimonyto her determination, hard work, and commitment towards her studies.On 18 th March 2023, Ms.Medishetty Srujana was felicitated with the prestigious Gold Medalfor academic excellence in B.Tech (Civil Engineering) by Dr.Tamilisai Soundararajan-Hon’ble Governor of Telengana state in a grand ceremony held at JNTUH. Her remarkableaccomplishments and contributions towards her academic field have earned her this well-deserved recognition.We, at MGIT, take immense pride in congratulating Ms.Medishetty Srujana. for heroutstanding achievements and recognition. We are confident that her determination, passion,and hard work will continue to pave the way for her success in all her future endeavours. Wewish her all the very best for her future.
